defects.expectedPosition: In center workspace or floating with proper cascaded offset without colliding with Camera
defects.ruleCausingIssue: src/panel/types.ts defaultPanelState hardcodes x: PANEL_MARGIN, y: PANEL_MARGIN for all panels; and registry.ts marks tasks as defaultOpen: true with floating placement, resulting in identical (256, 70) starting coordinates.
defects.correctiveAction: Cascade initial floating positions, avoid opening 5 overlapping windows on initial launch, or provide dedicated dashboard layout.

defects.expectedPosition: Above or cleanly integrated with ArcReactor centerpiece without occupying full stage inset
defects.ruleCausingIssue: src/App.css .core-caption has position: absolute; inset: 0;, while .arc-reactor has position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); causing text lines to paint directly over the reactor rings.
defects.correctiveAction: Refactor stage into a coherent flex/grid document flow where hero title and living text sit above or neatly frame the core status indicator.

defects.expectedPosition: Contained in center workspace between left and right panel columns
defects.ruleCausingIssue: .core-caption spans full width (1200px) from left to right edge of stage, intersecting with side-docked panels.
defects.correctiveAction: Constrain dashboard center stage to central column or render panels inside the structured grid.

defects.expectedPosition: Unified, compact command bar at bottom of workspace without competing orbital rings
defects.overlappingElement: None directly intersecting, but excessive vertical footprint (303px height) crowding the stage
defects.ruleCausingIssue: .jarvis-dock is a column with 12px gap, 88px voice button + 52px rings + status + composer + hints, consuming over 300px of vertical viewport.
defects.correctiveAction: Integrate the voice button and input controls into a unified horizontal or streamlined command bar, saving over 160px of vertical space.

defects.elementName: Panel Host System (.panel-host with 5 open windows on launch)
defects.expectedPosition: Clean dashboard with core metrics; windows open on demand when user clicks sidebar items or requests them
defects.overlappingElement: All 5 panels compete with center stage, ArcReactor, and dock
defects.ruleCausingIssue: PANEL_DEFINITIONS in src/panel/registry.ts sets defaultOpen: true on 5 panels simultaneously.
defects.correctiveAction: Structure the initial view as a pristine, professional dashboard with organized cards (Overview, Activity, Quick Actions) and allow panels to open cleanly as focused workspace views or drawers on demand.
